subject: general
question: What is the name of the new programme introduced by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) to promote innovation, collaboration, and research in India’s digital identity ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**"SITAA – Scheme for Innovation and Technology Association with Aadhaar"**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• UIDAI has introduced the SITAA programme to promote innovation, collaboration, and research in India's digital identity ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The initiative aims to make Aadhaar-based systems more secure, efficient, and globally competitive.
 
• UIDAI is partnering with startups, academic institutions, and technology companies for collaboration and research.
 
• The programme is being implemented with the support of the MeitY Startup Hub (MSH) and NASSCOM.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The SITAA programme focuses on enhancing India's digital identity infrastructure by fostering innovation.
